    sleep 60

sleep 5  # let filesystem flush

    log "ERROR: 10K checkpoint not found at $STAGE1_CKPT_DIR/$CKPT_STEP"
    log "Stage 1 likely exited abnormally. NOT starting Stage 2."
    exit 1
fi

    log "ERROR: model.safetensors missing in 10K checkpoint"
    exit 1
fi

log "10K checkpoint verified. Setting up Stage 2 directory..."

mkdir -p "$STAGE2_CKPT_DIR"
cp -r "$STAGE1_CKPT_DIR/$CKPT_STEP" "$STAGE2_CKPT_DIR/$CKPT_STEP"

log "Stage 2 dir ready at $STAGE2_CKPT_DIR"
ls -la "$STAGE2_CKPT_DIR/"

log "Starting Stage 2 training..."

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate libero
cd /root/colliforce-vla
export WANDB_MODE=disabled

python scripts/train_a1_sdf_aux_pi05.py \
    --scene object_pudding --seed 0 --lambda_sdf 0 \
    --gpu 1 --num_train_steps 30000 --resume \
    > "$STAGE2_LOG" 2>&1
EXIT_CODE=$?

log "Stage 2 finished with exit code $EXIT_CODE"
log "Training log: $STAGE2_LOG"
SENTINEL_EOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/auto_stage2_seed0.sh
